title: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope, structured JSON mode
description: Common envelope of every SLOPay event. The Kafka message value is the whole envelope; the Kafka key equals subject.

id.description: Event ID, unique within source. Consumers deduplicate by it; a repeated delivery of the same fact keeps the same ID.

time.description: When the producer recorded the fact.

subject.description: Aggregate the event is about; equals the Kafka key.

dataschema.description: $id of the versioned schema of this event. A breaking change is published as a new schema file and $id (<event>.v<N+1>.json).
